content:
rachel-finance: Medicurve raised a dispute for APR invoice — they want the full platform fee removed, claiming a data-center migration/outage lasted 24 hours and therefore platform fee shouldn't apply for that day. They attached an outage report.
omar-sales: spoke to their AM. Customer says they informed us via ops@redwood on 2026-04-02 and received an oral acknowledgement over a call. No written approval in ticketing.
kai-cs: checking telemetry — pool `med-prod` shows a `migration:dc-move` tag from 2026-04-02T03:10Z to 2026-04-02T08:25Z (about 5.25h). There's a separate incident `net-blip` at 2026-04-02T20:40Z but that's 15 minutes. No 24h outage evidence.
rachel-finance: invoice snapshot:
```
INV-2026-417
line 1: reserved_commit_hours 720 => $42,000
line 2: platform_fee (private) => $11,200
line 3: support_enterprise => $4,000
```
They want $11.2k credit.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-417 generated 2026-04-04T10:12Z. Metering: reserved_hours=720 for cust_med_009. Tag history shows `migration:dc-move` for 5.25h. No Redwood-approved exemption record found.
omar-sales: customer insists on parity with previous vendor that waived platform fees for migrations. They're pushing for a full rollback.
kai-cs: note: logs show they used on-demand nodes for ~3.5h post-migration for load tests — those are billable. We should only consider pro-rated platform fee for the 5.25h verified window.
sara-legal: contract clause review: SOW section 2.2 requires written pre-approval from Redwood for billing waiver. Oral confirmation is not sufficient.
nate-fp: recommend standardized offer: pro-rate platform fee for verified maintenance window + a discretionary goodwill top-up capped at $2,500 for private deployments. Approve up to that cap with AM signoff.
rachel-finance: calc: $11,200 / 720h = $15.56/hr. Pro-rated for 5.25h => $81.67. With discretionary cap we could offer up to $2,500; suggest we offer $1,250 as a compromise and require written acceptance of migration pre-approval process.
omar-sales: customer will press back on $1.25k but may accept with promise of policy change and a one-click pre-approval flow in Console.
qa: (ops note) we can add a Console toggle: "migration-exempt" request that opens an AM approval workflow. ETA ~3 sprints.
sara-legal: we'll require customer to acknowledge settlement email and accept updated onboarding terms for migrations.
rachel-finance: I'll draft credit memo CM-2026-412 for $1,250 pending acceptance. Ticket #billing-ops-9450. I'll set invoice status to `offer_pending`.
billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-412 created (amount $1,250). Ledger update pending signed acceptance.
omar-sales: I'll send the offer and coordinate the AM to get written acceptance. I'll also capture the call notes.
kai-cs: please note in ops: create alert rule to auto-calc pro-rate when `migration:` tag present and flag for AM approval if >1h. Rule id: ops-mig-2026-04.
rachel-finance: once signed, finance will apply CM-2026-412 and mark the invoice as `settled`.
ombot: (typing)
nb: closing: Medicurve accepted the $1,250 credit and signed the migration addendum. Marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
